dates.effective: Both stylized statewide laws in effect 1 January 2027

outcome.long: Housing units authorized by building permits, counted at permit issuance, all building sizes. Each reform's addition over current law comes from its own bundle; near major transit stops the headline takes the larger of the two in each place and year, with their sum shown as an upper bound, and elsewhere they are added.
outcome.short: Extra homes in issued building permits from a transit-oriented density law and a parking law together, compared with current law, Wisconsin, 2027–2031. Not completed homes.

title: Transit-oriented density and parking reform together

paths paired by role, never crossed
